answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is only 0.037, below every category's range (fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133, quantized 0.096-0.105). The layer-2 spike is 0.2, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). Quantized is also unlikely: the median first divergence is 1, the edit distance is 0.758, KL is 0.551, and refusals added is 8. Several features fit fine-tuning better: the activation difference grows steadily to 0.551 at layer 32, direction consistency is 0.614 (fine-tuned 0.618-0.705), refusals shifted by 8 added, and there are many more very short replies. The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.6 and the final-layer jump of +0.044 are in range for both fine-tuned and system-prompted, so they do not separate them. Several values lie outside the documented fine-tuned ranges (KL 0.551, edit distance 0.758, top-1 agreement 0.842, final-layer L2 0.551), so this may be a stronger fine-tune than those in the document. The strongest competitor is system-prompted, which matches on output divergence at the first token and on logit degradation, but it does not fit the near-zero layer-1 and layer-2 values.
